lesson41ExactAppRecords.question: What is the mean of {1,1,1,3,6,6}?
lesson41ExactAppRecords.feedback: The six observations total 18. Mean = 18/6 = 3. Count each repeated observation.
lesson41ExactAppRecords.sourceAttribution: User-provided Lesson 4.1 ungraded course question and correct-answer feedback, 2026-10-04

lesson41ExactAppRecords.question: What is the median of {1,1,1,3,6,6}?
lesson41ExactAppRecords.feedback: The data are sorted and n=6. The third and fourth values are 1 and 3, so median = (1+3)/2 = 2. Average the values, not their position numbers.
lesson41ExactAppRecords.sourceAttribution: User-provided Lesson 4.1 ungraded course question and correct-answer feedback, 2026-10-04

lesson41ExactAppRecords.question: What is the mode of {1,1,1,3,6,6}?
lesson41ExactAppRecords.feedback: 1 occurs three times, 6 twice, and 3 once. Only 1 has the greatest frequency. Repetition alone does not make 6 another mode.
lesson41ExactAppRecords.sourceAttribution: User-provided Lesson 4.1 ungraded course question and correct-answer feedback, 2026-10-04

lesson41ExactAppRecords.question: What is the mean of {2,3,5,5,7,8,8,9}?
lesson41ExactAppRecords.feedback: The total is 47 over eight observations. Mean = 47/8 = 5.875; keep the exact result when it appears among the choices.
lesson41ExactAppRecords.sourceAttribution: User-provided Lesson 4.1 ungraded course question and correct-answer feedback, 2026-10-04

lesson41ExactAppRecords.question: What is the median of {6,1,12,13,4,9,4}?
lesson41ExactAppRecords.feedback: Sort first: {1,4,4,6,9,12,13}. With seven observations, the fourth value is the median: 6.
lesson41ExactAppRecords.sourceAttribution: User-provided Lesson 4.1 ungraded course question and correct-answer feedback, 2026-10-04

lesson41ExactAppRecords.question: What are the modes of {2,3,5,5,7,8,8,9}?
lesson41ExactAppRecords.feedback: 5 and 8 each occur twice, tying for the highest frequency. Both are modes.
lesson41ExactAppRecords.sourceAttribution: User-provided Lesson 4.1 ungraded course question and correct-answer feedback, 2026-10-04
